parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the migration, synchronization, or tracking task.

parameters.name: JobStepId
parameters.description: The task step ID, which corresponds to the **synchronization** step ID returned by the ListJobStep API.

parameters.name: NewCheckPoint
parameters.description: The new offset as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The specified value must fall within the offset range of the incremental data collection step.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the DTS instance resides.

> For regions that support dedicated clusters, see [DTS dedicated cluster](~~417481~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
